rows.label: Basilica and Expiatory Church of the Holy Family
rows.description: basilica under construction since 1882 in Barcelona, Spain
rows.hook: remains unfinished after decades of construction and is famous for its tall, spire-covered facade

rows.label: Petronas Towers
rows.description: twin skyscrapers in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
rows.hook: was once the tallest building on Earth, known for its matching twin skyscrapers linked by a sky bridge

rows.label: Chrysler Building
rows.hook: is topped with a stainless-steel crown of stacked arches that lights up the New York skyline at night

rows.label: Fallingwater
rows.description: house designed by architect Frank Lloyd Wright in Pennsylvania
rows.hook: cantilevers dramatically above a rushing forest stream, blurring the line between house and nature

rows.label: Gateway Arch
rows.hook: is a soaring, stainless-steel monument shaped like a giant curve towering over the Mississippi riverfront

rows.label: Flatiron Building
rows.hook: has a narrow, triangular shape that tapers to a point where two streets meet in Manhattan

rows.label: Marina Bay Sands
rows.hook: supports a boat-shaped platform on its roof that holds an infinity pool overlooking the city skyline

rows.label: Burj al-Arab
rows.description: luxury hotel in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
rows.hook: is shaped like a giant sail rising from its own man-made island off the coast of Dubai

rows.label: Millau Viaduct
rows.hook: carries traffic across a valley on masts so tall their tops sometimes disappear into the clouds

rows.label: Lotus Temple
rows.description: Bahá'í House of Worship in Delhi, India
rows.hook: is shaped like a giant flower with white petal-like panels that unfold around a central hall

rows.label: Guggenheim Museum Bilbao
rows.description: Museum of modern and contemporary art in Bilbao, Spain
rows.hook: is covered in curving, shimmering titanium panels that reflect light like fish scales

rows.label: Casa Batlló
rows.hook: has a wavy, bone-like facade and a roof said to resemble the scales of a dragon's back
